name: reelbar
description: Instagram in your VS Code sidebar — a real Chrome runs invisibly and streams into the editor. Scroll reels beside your code, audio and all. No iframe, no proxy: Instagram sees a normal browser.

commands.title: Reelbar: Re-snap Dock to Edge (window mode)

reelbar.mode.description: sidebar: stream Instagram into a VS Code sidebar view (recommended). window: dock a separate chromeless browser window beside the editor (legacy).

reelbar.quality.description: JPEG quality of the sidebar video stream. Higher = sharper, more CPU.

reelbar.mobileUI.description: Virtual phone: present the hidden browser as an iPhone (390px-wide viewport, phone user agent) so Instagram serves its phone UI — full-bleed reels, one reel per screen, properly scaled buttons at any sidebar size. On by default; the desktop layout reserves a fixed 138px action column that forces a second reel into view on narrow sidebars. Applies after Reload Page / Restart Browser. Turn off if Instagram misbehaves.

reelbar.reelHeight.description: Virtual phone only: maximum height (px) of the emulated phone viewport. Instagram's mobile web reels is a scrolling feed, so a taller viewport shows more than one reel at a time — this caps it. Default 844 keeps the previous behaviour. Lower it to fit fewer reels per screen (a 9:16 reel at 390px wide is ~693 tall); lower = more zoomed in, with slight letterboxing on tall sidebars. Applies immediately.
reelbar.reelHeight.markdownDescription:
Virtual phone only: maximum height (px) of the emulated phone viewport. Instagram's mobile web reels is a scrolling feed, so a taller viewport shows more than one reel at a time — this caps it.

Default `844` keeps the previous behaviour. Lower it to fit fewer reels per screen (a 9:16 reel at 390px wide is ~`693` tall); lower = more zoomed in, with slight letterboxing on tall sidebars. Applies immediately.

reelbar.muteWhenHidden.description: Mute Instagram when the sidebar view is hidden. Off by default so audio keeps playing (podcast mode). The video stream always pauses when hidden; only audio is affected.

reelbar.url.description: Page to open. Default is the Instagram home feed.

reelbar.browserPath.description: Absolute path to a Chromium-based browser binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (Chrome → Brave → Edge → Chromium).

reelbar.dockSide.description: Window mode only: which screen edge the Instagram window snaps to.

reelbar.width.description: Window mode only: width of the docked Instagram window, in pixels.

reelbar.menuBarOffset.description: Window mode only: pixels to leave at the top for the macOS menu bar.
